name: Segmentation-Driven Directionally Adaptive DWT
definition: Application of 2D SD-DA-DWT on volumetric datasets by segmenting slices separately and decomposing with 2D SD-DA-DWT using (6,6) kernel.
summary: Segmentation-Driven Directionally Adaptive DWT is a wavelet compression method that adapts transform direction locally using irregular, gradient-based segments to maximize directional adaptability at sample resolution.
